observations: Photo 0 shows the rear of a rack-mounted server with multiple network ports, power connectors, and cooling fans. The chassis is silver-gray, and there are two yellow warning stickers.

Photo 1 shows the internal components of the server: motherboard with multiple CPU sockets, RAM slots, expansion slots, and a large silver drive backplane. The motherboard has blue capacitors and white labels with part numbers.
Photo 2 shows the front of the server with two drive bays, a power button, and status LEDs. The front panel has a label with a barcode and model information, but it is too small to read clearly.
All photos have a watermark: 'I.G SERVER TECH POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: Seller's words. The front panel label in photo 2 is too small to read, but the rear and internal layout in photos 0 and 1 are consistent with DL380 G9 design.
No CPU visible in photos. The motherboard in photo 1 has two CPU sockets, but no CPU is installed or labeled. The model is consistent with supporting this CPU, but not proven.
Photo 1 shows multiple RAM slots, but no RAM modules are installed. The slots are empty. No labels or visible memory sticks.
No RAID controller card is visible in photo 1. The drive backplane is present, but no controller card is shown. The model supports P440ar, but not confirmed.
Photo 2 shows drive bays, but no drives are installed. The bays are empty. No drives visible in any photo.
Photo 0 shows two power connectors, but no power supplies are visible inside. The rear has two power input ports, but the PSUs themselves are not shown.

risks.proof: Photo showing the installed CPUs with model numbers visible, or a close-up of the CPU sockets with CPUs seated.
Photo showing installed RAM modules with capacity labels visible.
Photo showing installed 300GB drives with model numbers visible.
Photo showing the P440ar RAID controller card installed in a PCIe slot.
Photo showing the two 750W power supplies installed in the chassis.

risks.risk: Server not tested or not functional
risks.proof: Video or photo of the server powered on, showing POST, BIOS, or OS boot.

proof_requests: Photo of installed CPUs with model numbers visible.
Photo of installed RAM modules with capacity labels.
Photo of installed 300GB drives with model numbers.
Photo of installed P440ar RAID controller.
Video or photo of the server powered on and booting.
response.reason: The server model is identified as HP Proliant DL380 G9 from the seller's words and consistent photos, but all key components (CPUs, RAM, drives, RAID controller, PSUs) are unverified as installed. Without proof of installation and functionality, the item cannot be priced as working. The photos show an empty chassis, so the worst-case price is as not working, but proof is needed to raise it.
